// Generated by the verify-ui Gradle plugin. Do not edit: it is rewritten on every build.
package verifyui.runtime

import android.content.res.Configuration
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.CompositionLocalProvider
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalConfiguration
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalDensity
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalLayoutDirection
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.ComposeContentTestRule
import androidx.compose.ui.test.onRoot
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Density
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.LayoutDirection
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.github.takahirom.roborazzi.captureRoboImage
import sergio.sastre.composable.preview.scanner.android.AndroidComposablePreviewScanner
import sergio.sastre.composable.preview.scanner.android.AndroidPreviewInfo
import sergio.sastre.composable.preview.scanner.core.preview.ComposablePreview
import java.io.File

/** A rendering condition applied on top of a preview. */
data class Variant(val suffix: String, val fontScale: Float = 1f, val rtl: Boolean = false, val dark: Boolean = false) {
    companion object {
        val AsIs = Variant("")
        val FontScale2x = Variant("font_2x", fontScale = 2f)
        val Rtl = Variant("rtl", rtl = true)
        val Dark = Variant("dark", dark = true)
    }
}

/** One render: a preview of a component in a state, under a variant. */
class RenderCase(
    val component: String,
    val state: String,
    val variant: Variant,
    val preview: ComposablePreview<AndroidPreviewInfo>?,
) {
    val fileName: String get() = if (variant.suffix.isEmpty()) state else "${state}__${variant.suffix}"
    override fun toString() = if (preview == null) "no-previews/$component" else "$component/$fileName"
}

object RenderCases {

    fun load(): List<RenderCase> {
        val target = System.getProperty("verifyui.composable").orEmpty()
        val packages = System.getProperty("verifyui.packages").orEmpty().split(',').filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        val previews = AndroidComposablePreviewScanner()
            .scanPackageTrees(*packages.toTypedArray())
            .includePrivatePreviews()
            .getPreviews()
            .filter { target.isEmpty() || matches(it, target) }

        val cases = mutableListOf<RenderCase>()
        for ((component, group) in previews.groupBy { componentOf(it, target) }.toSortedMap()) {
            val used = mutableSetOf<String>()
            val named = group.map { p ->
                var s = stateOf(p, component)
                var n = 2
                while (!used.add(s)) s = "${stateOf(p, component)}_${n++}"
                p to s
            }
            val base = named.firstOrNull { it.second == "default" } ?: named.first()
            for ((p, s) in named) {
                cases += RenderCase(component, s, Variant.AsIs, p)
                if (p === base.first) {
                    cases += RenderCase(component, s, Variant.FontScale2x, p)
                    cases += RenderCase(component, s, Variant.Rtl, p)
                    cases += RenderCase(component, s, Variant.Dark, p)
                }
            }
        }
        if (cases.isEmpty()) cases += RenderCase(target.ifEmpty { "*" }, "", Variant.AsIs, null)
        return cases
    }

    private fun simpleClass(p: ComposablePreview<*>) = p.declaringClass.toString().substringAfterLast('.').removeSuffix("Kt")

    private fun matches(p: ComposablePreview<*>, target: String) =
        simpleClass(p) == target || p.methodName.contains(target)

    private fun componentOf(p: ComposablePreview<*>, target: String) = target.ifEmpty { simpleClass(p) }

    /** OrderSummaryCardLongTextPreview -> long_text; OrderSummaryCardPreview -> default. */
    private fun stateOf(p: ComposablePreview<AndroidPreviewInfo>, component: String): String {
        val raw = p.previewInfo.name.ifBlank {
            p.methodName.replace(component, "").replace("Preview", "")
        }
        val snake = raw.trim('_', ' ')
            .replace(Regex("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])"), "$1_$2")
            .replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9]+"), "_")
            .trim('_')
            .lowercase()
        val index = p.previewIndex
        val withIndex = if (index != null && index > 0) "${snake.ifEmpty { "default" }}_$index" else snake
        return withIndex.ifEmpty { "default" }
    }
}

object Renderer {

    fun render(compose: ComposeContentTestRule, case: RenderCase) {
        val root = File(System.getProperty("verifyui.outputDir") ?: "build/verify-ui").apply { mkdirs() }
        val preview = case.preview
        if (preview == null) {
            File(root, "_no_previews.txt").writeText(case.component)
            return
        }
        val dir = File(root, case.component).apply { mkdirs() }
        try {
            compose.setContent { VariantHost(case.variant) { preview() } }
            compose.onRoot().captureRoboImage(File(dir, "${case.fileName}.png").path)
            val node = compose.onRoot(useUnmergedTree = true).fetchSemanticsNode()
            File(dir, "${case.fileName}.semantics.json").writeText(
                SemanticsDump.toJson(
                    node,
                    mapOf(
                        "component" to case.component,
                        "state" to case.state,
                        "variant" to case.variant.suffix,
                        "fontScale" to case.variant.fontScale,
                        "rtl" to case.variant.rtl,
                        "dark" to case.variant.dark,
                        "preview" to "${preview.declaringClass}.${preview.methodName}",
                    ),
                ),
            )
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            File(dir, "${case.fileName}.error.txt").writeText(t.stackTraceToString())
        }
    }
}

/** Applies a variant through the same CompositionLocals the platform would set. */
@Composable
fun VariantHost(variant: Variant, content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val baseDensity = LocalDensity.current
    val baseConfig = LocalConfiguration.current
    val config = Configuration(baseConfig).apply {
        if (variant.dark) {
            uiMode = (uiMode and Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_MASK.inv()) or Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_YES
        }
        fontScale = baseConfig.fontScale * variant.fontScale
    }
    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalConfiguration provides config,
        LocalDensity provides Density(baseDensity.density, baseDensity.fontScale * variant.fontScale),
        LocalLayoutDirection provides if (variant.rtl) LayoutDirection.Rtl else LayoutDirection.Ltr,
    ) {
        // Window-like background, so transparent previews are judged against a realistic surface.
        Box(Modifier.background(if (variant.dark) Color(0xFF121212) else Color.White).padding(8.dp)) {
            content()
        }
    }
}
